stages.name: pre_due
stages.template: Hi {name}, this is a friendly reminder that invoice {invoice_no} of Rs {amount} is due in 2 days on {due_date}. Please arrange payment at your earliest convenience.

stages.name: due_day
stages.template: Hi {name}, invoice {invoice_no} of Rs {balance} is due today. Please make the payment to avoid any late charges. Thank you!

stages.name: soft_followup
stages.template: Hi {name}, we noticed invoice {invoice_no} of Rs {balance} (due {due_date}) is still outstanding. Please pay at your earliest. Let us know if you need help.

stages.name: firm_followup
stages.template: Hi {name}, invoice {invoice_no} of Rs {balance} is now 7 days overdue. Immediate payment is required to avoid disruption to your account. Reply PROMISE <date> if you need a few more days.

stages.name: final_notice
stages.template: Hi {name}, FINAL NOTICE: invoice {invoice_no} of Rs {balance} is 15 days overdue. We are escalating this to our manager. Please pay immediately or reply DISPUTE if there is an issue.
